Title: Keepers
Amendment_Text: 2020 AMENDMENT: Effective 2021, The Maximum number of players a GM can keep is 4.  This does not limit the GM to using 4 Different keeper slots (Example: Keeping a player in the first round, 1 player in the fourth round, and two players in the 16th Round)

Title: Don't Fuck Up Deposit
Amendment_Text: Events should only be considered fuck-ups if there is a negative impact on one or more member(s) of the league "Fucked Up" Examples The following events are considered events of “Fucking up” -Starting an injured player -Starting a player on a bye -Not starting the best possible player for a particular position when there is a clear better option Example: Leaving a top rated player on your bench the week after a bye, leaving an RB3/4 in your lineup -Missing the Keeper Deadline and Requesting a 24 Hour Extension (2019 Amendment: The League vs. Christopher Polizois & Daniel Gutman) Fuckups incrementally increase by $5 per fuck up (Effective 2021)

Title: Divisions & Schedule
Amendment_Text: Starting with the year 2020; Divisions will be changed for 3 to 2. The divisions will be re-aligned every 3 years and the two GM's with the best overall record, most points, best average finish over the course of those 3 years will Draft the other GM's into their respective Division in a Snake Draft Format. (1st Place gets 1st Pick, 2nd place gets 2nd & 3rd Pick, etc.)
